series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Hakari breaks down in tears and tells Rentarou she cannot go on, right as her mother Hahari appears. Hahari has been quietly worrying for a long time and gently delivers her verdict on the relationship, while Hakari's small denial shows the first crack.
Prior events (Part 2): With Hakari pulled away, the other girlfriends gather at the mansion. The mood swings from uneasy comedy to desperation, a girl collapses in the hallway, and the group realizes winning Hakari back will take an actual operation.
Prior events (Part 3): Rentarou rallies the girls and wins an audience with Hahari. The meeting turns tense fast, and inside the family altar room he discovers the portrait of Hakari's late father smiling down at him.
Prior events (Part 4): At the altar, Hahari asks why Rentarou faced her alone, then exposes the wound underneath: her first love died, and she has wondered ever since whether that love was real. Rentarou answers with a vow to believe and prove it.
Prior events (Part 5): Hahari breaks. In front of the altar she confesses her love, cries into Rentarou's chest and begs for a kiss, then panics over the all-important first kiss and bolts, already regretting everything.
Prior events (Part 6): Back with the girls, exhaustion and relief hit at once. Hahari formally asks to join them for a day, then tells Rentarou she loves him too in front of everyone, and this time nobody stops the kiss.
Prior events (Part 7): A white-haired figure appears in the dark hallway: the spirit of Hakari's father, who has watched over the family for sixteen years. He gives Rentarou his blessing, entrusts him with his children's future, and fades as Hahari renews the promise she once made him.
